title: 3rd United States Congress
summary: The English Wikipedia article "3rd United States Congress", at revision 1380236762, opens: "The 3rd United States Congress was a meeting of the legislative branch of the United States federal government, consisting of the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives. It met at Congress Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania from March 4, 1793, to March 4, 1795, during the fifth and sixth years of George Washington's presidency." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q223336, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "legislative term from 1793-1795". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
